scope: Source review of the additive two independently placed WidgetKit-instance acceptance; no concurrency, cold-start, VoiceOver or physical-device completion claim.
reviewedBoundaries: The observer reads actual current MiniApps/catalog/package/program/widget state and the installed app/extension/XCTest/MCM identities; it does not write production state.

The prepared Matrix archive digest is bound through the actual PackageCenter source contentSHA256, preparedSourceBundle packageContentDigest and installation plan sourceDigest chain, rather than assuming widget.jsx is the package digest.
Both actual Edit Widget selections and distinct physical accessibility frames are retained before and after six sequential native actions.

Every successful action requires one fresh native invocation UUID and exactly one revision increase; typed boolean/count values, current cache, immutable other-instance state and the otherStatesSHA remain bound.
Fresh final configuration/state and current MCM/app/extension checks precede terminal completion.
The existing UI methods, runner plans and shared helper bodies are retained; R2 only relocates the new controls into original Scripts/CI/Tests discovery and updates the observer source path.
limits: Actual WidgetKit gallery/placement/accessibility behavior must pass the original native pilot; source review is not OS success.
Legacy failed-gallery evidence does not establish a successfully placed widget.
